name: Onboarding Tour opens from the sidebar and shows the not-cloned state
description: From the app root (redirects to the seeded demo repo acme/payments-api), click the Onboarding Tour sidebar entry and confirm /repos/<id>/onboarding renders the readiness message and its Check again button. The seeded repo has no local clone, so no tour can be generated: read-only, no model call, and no Generate control is clicked. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo is the first repo (run via ./scripts/e2e.sh). Separate from flow 06, which covers the add-repository screen at /onboarding.

steps.label: load the app root (redirects to the demo repo)
land on the repo's PR list
open the Onboarding Tour from the sidebar
the repo-scoped onboarding route is reached
